observation.command:
source /etc/xplanbox.env
export CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-dienste/tomcat.pid
/opt/tomcat-dienste/bin/startup.sh 2>&1
sleep 5
/opt/tomcat-anwendung/bin/startup.sh 2>&1
sleep 5
/opt/tomcat-api/bin/startup.sh 2>&1
sleep 5
echo "=== java/tomcat processes ==="
ps aux | grep -E "[c]atalina|[t]omcat" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $11, $12}' | head
